def length_2d(self) -> float:
    """
    Computes 2-dimensional length of the GPX file (only latitude and
    longitude, no elevation). This is the sum of 2D length of all segments
    in all tracks.

    Returns
    ----------
    length : float
        Length returned in meters
    """

        if length:
            result += length
